description: There's a strong smell of gas in the kitchen and I feel a bit dizzy.
note: Gas leak + physical symptoms. Category 1 health hazard.

description: Black mould is spreading across the bedroom ceiling and my baby sleeps in that room.
note: Awaab's Law: damp/mould with a vulnerable occupant.

description: There's condensation on the windows every morning and a musty smell in the bathroom.
note: TRAP: sounds routine but is early damp/mould. Post-Awaab this must be assessed as a hazard.

description: The kitchen tap drips constantly, day and night.
No hot water or heating at all, it's freezing and my elderly mother lives with me.
note: Total heat/hot-water loss in cold weather with a vulnerable occupant.

description: There's a burning smell coming from a plug socket and it's warm to the touch.
The front door lock is broken and the door won't lock at all.
note: Security, not a health hazard. Priority without hazard flag.

description: There's a cracked tile in the hallway, purely cosmetic.
A damp patch on the living room wall keeps getting bigger and the wallpaper is peeling.
The toilet won't flush and it's the only toilet in the property.
note: Sole WC out of use; urgent but not a health hazard per se.

description: There's a leak from the flat above and water is coming through the light fitting.
The bedroom door hinge squeaks.
My son's asthma has got much worse and there's black spotting on the wall behind his bed.
A garden fence panel blew down in the wind last night.
Emergency! I really need my kitchen cupboard door rehung, it fell off.
note: TRAP: tenant uses 'emergency' but it's cosmetic. Tests keyword over-triggering.

description: There's a sewage smell and water is backing up in the bathroom drain.
The radiator in the lounge isn't getting warm, but the rest of the house is fine.
note: Partial heat loss, other rooms fine. Tests urgency calibration (not an emergency).

description: Water is pouring through the kitchen ceiling and I can't stop it.
The paint is peeling in the hallway, it just looks tired.
There's slight mould in the corner of the bathroom ceiling, it's been there a while.
note: TRAP: tenant downplays it, but post-Awaab any reported mould is a hazard to assess. Tests over-deference to casual framing.
